name: Whirlpool Top-Mount Defrost Heater (W10330404)
purpose: Dual-loop defrost heater on WRT/W8T/W4T top-mount — verify against tech sheet when available.
failureModes: Open heater — no defrost, heavy evaporator frost
Short to sheath — ground fault; verify infinity from lead to sheath
testingTips: Power disconnected; unplug heater harness at evaporator
Example spec: ~30 Ω installed, ~33 Ω uninstalled (W10330404 §4-5)

name: Whirlpool Top-Mount Defrost Bimetal / Terminator
purpose: Defrost termination thermostat — closes below ~40°F frosted evaporator; opens 45–60°F after defrost.
failureModes: Open when evaporator frosted — heater never energizes
Stuck closed — extended defrost / warm product
testingTips: Test at harness with power off
Frosted evaporator and bimetal cold: <1 Ω closed

name: Whirlpool Top-Mount PTC Start Device (cold)
purpose: PTC thermistor start relay — cold resistance before heat-up; hot/open = failed or recently tripped.
failureModes: OL when cold — open PTC; compressor won't start
Stays low after heat — stuck; allow 10 min cool-down before retest
testingTips: Disconnect from compressor; test cold only
~5 Ω cold; within 1–3 s under power rises to 100kΩ+
Do not rapid-cycle — wait ~10 min between attempts

name: Whirlpool Top-Mount Condenser Fan (shaded pole)
purpose: Shaded-pole condenser fan motor winding — forced-air condenser models only.
failureModes: Stepper evap/condenser motors cannot be ohm-tested — use 120 VAC functional test
testingTips: Disconnect wires; ohm across motor leads
